claims.statement: UK remote licensees must embed identify, act and evaluate as an ongoing customer-interaction process.
Licensees must evaluate overall effectiveness, quality-assure records, trial approaches and retain evidence of interaction outcomes.
The Commission reports 20,497,383 online customer interactions for 2025-2026, 96% indirect, while saying it does not yet collect quality or impact data.
A 2025 Spreadex enforcement action imposed a GBP 2.022 million penalty for combined AML and social-responsibility failings and required a third-party audit.
Solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects are restricted and require safeguards including human intervention and challenge routes.
Profiling intended to infer health status or health risk is special-category processing and needs an Article 9 condition.
BetBuddy and GameScanner already offer operator-wide risk classification, explainable behavioural analytics and intervention support.
Massachusetts Gaming Commission meeting materials report typical BetBuddy base pricing of USD 5000 monthly up to 25000 active monthly players and USD 8000 above that, with extra real-time costs.

contrary_evidence: BetBuddy and Mindway AI already cover core detection, explainability, dashboards and intervention support, so a generic risk API is not a differentiated entry.
Regulator-published BetBuddy pricing demonstrates budget but also sets a strong incumbent benchmark; a narrower product cannot assume the original price without paid validation.
The Commission says it does not currently collect interaction quality or impact, leaving a measurement gap but no proof that operators will pay a separate vendor to close it.
Operators remain accountable for customer interaction even when third parties supply tooling, so software cannot replace governance or human review.
Causal attribution from an intervention to later behaviour is confounded by concurrent controls and customer circumstances.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: permissioned mappings between indicators, interventions and observed outcomes plus recurrent control-defect patterns, kept client-segregated unless aggregation rights are explicit
fingerprint.customer: licensed remote gambling operators with an existing risk-detection process but weak intervention measurement, follow-up evidence and audit provenance
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: safer-gambling consultants, player-account-platform integrators, independent control auditors and narrowly scoped paid design partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: secure event ingestion, explainable case assembly, human-approved intervention workflow, outcome windows, quality-assurance sampling and regulator-ready audit exports
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the licensed operator pays for a production integration and recurring monitored-account, case-workflow and evidence-retention service
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a harm indicator prompts action and the operator must record, follow up, evaluate impact and demonstrate that its overall approach works

founder_fit: Strong neuroscience, behavioural-data and model-monitoring adjacency with a socially protective purpose.
A narrow batch analytics and audit pilot can fit the founder's part-time limit; real-time reliability, domain assurance and enterprise sales must be delegated before production scale.
The founder's interest in gambling creates a governance risk: product metrics must optimize harm reduction only, with independent safer-gambling review and no engagement optimization.
Production security and legal work may exceed currently available capital, so a paid evidence-audit pilot must precede a streaming build.
risks: False negatives can expose customers to harm; false positives can trigger unjustified restrictions.
Automated significant actions without meaningful human review can breach data-protection safeguards.
A model intended to infer gambling-harm health risk may process special-category data.
The UK licensing classification is fact-specific: general performance analytics is described as outside core gambling software, but functionality that controls gambling must receive legal review.
Security, incident response and on-call expectations may exceed the founder's time and capital.
The founder's personal gambling interest could bias priorities unless safety governance is explicit.

structure.commercial_archetype: operator-side intervention measurement and evidence utility
structure.control_point: the quality-assured record linking a risk signal, accountable human decision, action, follow-up and measured outcome
structure.critical_dependency: lawful access to event and interaction data, reliable outcome labels, human review and operator willingness to buy an independent layer beside incumbent tooling

thesis: Provide licensed remote operators with a human-approved evidence layer that links existing harm indicators to actions, follow-up windows, behaviour changes, quality assurance and regulator-ready records. Research supports a mandatory identify-act-evaluate workflow and a large interaction volume, but also shows mature risk-detection incumbents; the defensible wedge is therefore intervention measurement and provenance rather than another generic risk score. Cross-client learning is contingent on explicit rights and should begin with segregated per-operator analytics.
title: Safer-Gambling Intervention Measurement and Audit Layer
uncertainties: Paid willingness to buy a separate measurement layer rather than an incumbent suite or internal build.
Completeness and consistency of intervention labels and follow-up data.
Lawful bases and contractual rights for inferred health risk and any cross-operator learning.
Whether operator procurement permits a part-time founder-led vendor before formal security assurance.
Whether consultant and platform channels will commit rather than merely express interest.
True integration cost, sales cycle, support burden and outcome-measure reliability.
